profile.name: Laura Mulati
profile.title: Communications | Knowledge Management | Program Development Specialist
profile.summary: Results-oriented Communications, Knowledge Management, and Program Development Specialist with extensive experience delivering high-impact advocacy, digital marketing, partner due diligence, and information governance across international non-governmental organizations (INGOs) and civil society. Proven expertise in multi-channel content creation, partner engagement, project monitoring, and gender-transformative programming. Recognized for exceptional organizational acuity, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to streamline knowledge systems in fast-paced environments.

highlights.title: Grant Administration
highlights.desc: Coordinate application workflows for the Bahari Boost Challenge Fund (BBCF), managing preliminary screening, compliance documentation verification, and applicant communications.

highlights.title: Partner Due Diligence
highlights.desc: Execute due diligence assessments for local partner organizations, synthesizing findings and mapping organizational risk factors.

highlights.title: Monitoring & Reporting
highlights.desc: Review progress reports submitted by partner organizations and grantees, flagging gaps and maintaining structured reporting repositories for donor compliance.

highlights.title: Documentation Management
highlights.desc: Maintain Access to Finance trackers and records to ensure alignment with program and donor requirements.

highlights.title: Program Execution
highlights.desc: Coordinated program planning, budgeting, and field implementation across GBV response initiatives and economic empowerment projects.

highlights.title: Monitoring & Evaluation
highlights.desc: Conducted field monitoring visits, evaluated output data, and refined narrative reports to capture measurable outcomes.

highlights.title: Advocacy & Digital Communications
highlights.desc: Developed and deployed digital campaign messaging across COVAW platforms, improving organizational visibility and engagement.

highlights.title: Resource Development
highlights.desc: Co-authored communication toolkits and advocacy manuals; conducted needs assessments for survivors of GBV and women in informal sectors.

highlights.title: Media & Event Management
highlights.desc: Facilitated institutional public forums, advocacy workshops, and media pressers; drafted synthesis reports, minutes, and press kits.

highlights.title: Stakeholder Mapping & Coalition Building
highlights.desc: Identified and mapped strategic civil society partners, fostering coalition building for joint accountability initiatives.

highlights.title: Digital Advocacy & Monitoring
highlights.desc: Managed daily social media operations and conducted media monitoring to track anti-corruption coverage across national outlets.

highlights.title: Event Coordination
highlights.desc: Coordinated partner outreach, invitations, and venue logistics for the flagship Sauti initiative launch.

highlights.title: Database & Knowledge Archival
highlights.desc: Overhauled Twaweza's master media contact database; categorized physical and digital library collections using standardized information science protocols.

highlights.title: Content Creation & Transcription
highlights.desc: Produced multi-media content for digital platforms and transcribed public policy discussions on service delivery.

highlights.title: Content Strategy & Design
highlights.desc: Designed visual branding assets in Canva and scheduled cross-platform social media content calendars.

highlights.title: Automation & CMS
highlights.desc: Managed Mailchimp email campaigns to boost lead conversion; updated web content via WordPress and tracked KPIs with Google Analytics.

highlights.title: Digitization & Registry Optimization
highlights.desc: Spearheaded digital migration of legacy birth/death records; recommended filing system modifications that improved departmental efficiency.

highlights.title: Editorial & Cataloging
highlights.desc: Designed and published internal weekly newsletters; cataloged, classified, and indexed library materials for stakeholder retrieval.

projects.title: Bahari Boost Challenge Fund — Access to Finance Support
projects.summary: Support grant administration, due diligence, and monitoring & reporting for the Bahari Boost Challenge Fund, a blue-economy grant facility for youth-led coastal enterprises under TechnoServe's BlueBiz program.

projects.title: GBV Response & Economic Empowerment Programming
projects.summary: Coordinated program planning and field monitoring for gender-based violence response initiatives; co-authored communication toolkits and advocacy manuals for survivors and women in informal sectors.

projects.title: Anti-Corruption Advocacy & Media Engagement
projects.summary: Facilitated public forums and advocacy workshops, managed social media advocacy, and conducted media monitoring in support of TI-Kenya's governance and accountability initiatives.

projects.title: Sauti Launch & Stakeholder Engagement
projects.summary: Coordinated the launch of Twaweza's flagship Sauti citizen-voice initiative — partner outreach, media mobilization, and knowledge archival of the master media contact database.

projects.title: Digital Marketing & Brand Content
projects.summary: Delivered social media content calendars, email marketing automation, and web analytics reporting for client brands as a remote digital marketing virtual assistant.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Information Science and Knowledge Management
education.detail: Specialization: Communications, Publishing, and Media Studies. Conferred Degree with Honors (24 March 2021).
